title: Slice 4 (Gate execution + mutation floor) phase-1a design — vsdd way: red-gate/phase-exit gate command, terminal-round check, fix-lane approval machinery, mutation floor (extends Slice 1's vsdd gate; NOT the defunct mdatron client)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DRAFT authored the vsdd way: .design/gate-execution-slice.md (15 REQ / 19 AC, grounded in contract 275/192/81/177 + Slice-1 code). REUSES (not duplicates): vsdd gate, unrouted_findings + gate_verdict (integrity.rs), routing-gate CI, gate-data.md, state-schema GateResult/GateKind. ADDS: red-gate checkout-and-run at layer+fix scale, executed-pin discipline, the 3 removal lanes + set-equality approval, invocation stamp, graded retrofit, no-executed-pin forms, mutation floor, terminal-round check. 5 open questions: (Q1) mutation tool + kill-ratio floor (cargo-mutants absent from repo; floor unfilled); (Q2) gate command surface (subcommands vs top-level); (Q3) removal-lane approval-record format; (Q4) invocation-stamp representation (GateResult lacks a stamp field); (Q5) fix-lane checkout-and-run fixture seam (corpus is snapshot-based). Named split respected: round-parity/never-started = Slice 6. kickoff plan stalled + cleaned. Open questions to operator.
